visual_review.observations: Stacked woven trays with bound raised rims and pink, green and turquoise strips; other trays, bundled sticks and sacks remain in the source frame. Weave and rim detail remain legible in the 1200px candidate. Naturally darker upper area and lighter foreground retained. No person is pictured.
visual_review.assessment: Suitable authentic subject image for draft and future full-frame article/preview at normal reading widths.
limits: The source frame already clips neighbouring objects; no claim that every tray is wholly visible.
